meta.title: Dilan Mirror
howItWorks.items.item1Text: The rear view function of the object displayed in the mirror is activated via the touch panel, a hand gesture, thanks to a special motion sensor or a voice command.
howItWorks.items.item2Text: The sensors can be installed anywhere depending on the interior. When there is no movement of people, the system is automatically switched off.
howItWorks.items.item3Text: The camera is covered by a flap and is visible when activated so that the person is not uncomfortable with the feeling of constant surveillance.
howItWorks.items.item4Text: The translucent mirror allows you to hide the screen and show it when needed.
howItWorks.items.item5Text: Intelligent backlight points on the top and sides change the intensity of the backlight when the video signal is turned on or off.
howItWorks.items.item6Text: Video quality is customizable from 4k, 60fps and up, and high-quality components avoid broadcast latency.
arguments.item1.title: Room illumination
arguments.item1.description: Mirrors maximize even minimal sunlight during the day and artificial light in the evening
arguments.item2.title: Expansion of space
arguments.item2.description: Even the illusion of increased living space makes small rooms more comfortable
arguments.item3.title: Daily requirement
arguments.item3.description: A person looks in the mirror an average of 8 to 12 times during the day
arguments.item4.title: Fitness, beauty, etc.
arguments.item4.description: The actual and potential benefits of mirrors have been proven over 2000 years of their existence

intro.proposalText: El proyecto Dilan Mirror es la producción y venta de espejos que le permiten ver la parte posterior de su cuerpo con la máxima comodidad. Esta opción se puede activar o desactivar fácilmente en cualquier momento. Y si durante miles de años el espejo se ha visto privado de esta posibilidad, hoy estamos cambiando los estándares tradicionales.
examples.title: Casos de uso
examples.description:
Nuestro producto tiene más de 20 formas de uso.
Aquí están los más populares: probadores, agencias de modelos,gimnasios, uso privado, salones de tatuajes, camerinos de actores, rehabilitación médica y fisioterapia, juegos de escape y parques.
arguments.imageSubHeadLine:
Cada pocos años aparece un nuevo producto revolucionario que cambia toda la propia industria.
Sea parte del cambio en todos los sectores de su industria espejo.
